name: Ramsey
seo_title: Ramsey Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 2 Events, 0 Free
seo_desc: Ramsey has a December 1 tree lighting at City Hall with Santa and a Mini-Market, plus sensory-friendly Santa photos at Northern Starz.
lede: Ramsey has a December 1 tree lighting at City Hall with Santa and a Mini-Market, plus sensory-friendly Santa photos at Northern Starz.
celebrates: Ramsey starts December early. The City of Ramsey and PACT Charter School host the Community Tree Lighting at City Hall on December 1, with Santa and Mrs. Claus, a Mini-Market and a 6 pm ceremony outside, according to the city's posts. Northern Starz, on Alpine Drive, offers a sensory-friendly photos with Santa session for families who want a quieter visit.
lastyear: We did not find a city recap of the 2025 tree lighting, so this page sticks to the 2026 details. The city's community events calendar lists the tree lighting among its regular annual events.
facts: Ramsey City Hall is at 7550 Sunwood Drive NW. The city's community events calendar lists the tree lighting from 5 to 7:30 pm and shows City Hall closed on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. The tree lighting is hosted with PACT Charter School, according to the Facebook event.
trains: Ramsey has no train ride of its own that we could verify. The Northstar commuter rail line has a Ramsey station on the Big Lake to Minneapolis route. The CPKC Holiday Train stops in Hastings on December 12 at 8:45 pm, in Cottage Grove on December 13 at 5:15 pm and at Saint Paul Union Depot on December 13 at 7 pm, with free concerts, according to Explore Minnesota. The Minnesota Transportation Museum runs Santa's Train Shop and Caboose Rides at the Jackson Street Roundhouse, 193 Pennsylvania Ave E in Saint Paul, with pictures with Santa on the North Pole Mail Train, caboose rides, crafts and story time from 10 am to 4 pm, according to the museum.
